game.name: Bigs 2, The (USA)
game.desc: The Bigs 2 on Xbox 360 is a very arcade baseball game that offers several bonuses to increase players' performance. Players will be able to hit balls at the speed of light or jump to incredible heights. The title allows you to play each of the 162 games of a season, a championship or to take part in the "Become a Legend" mode.
